entities.summary: Doctor Miguel Núñez de Sanabria was a Spanish official in Peru and an oidor (judge) of the Audiencia of Lima. Twice he was interim viceroy of Peru, in virtue of his office as president of the Audiencia.

entities.summary: Doctor Miguel Núñez de Sanabria was a Spanish official in Peru and an oidor (judge) of the Audiencia of Lima. Twice he was interim viceroy of Peru, in virtue of his office as president of the Audiencia.
